record.paper_title: Some open problems on well-filtered spaces and sober spaces
record.original_question: Is the product space of an arbitrary family of well-filtered determined T0 spaces again well-filtered determined, i.e. are all irreducible closed subsets of the product WD sets?

evidence.quote: Question 5.24. ([51]) Is the product space of an arbitrary family of well-filtered determined spaces well-filtered determined?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let all topological spaces be $T_0$. Recall the following definitions.

(1) A subset $A$ of a topological space $X$ is irreducible if $A\neq\emptyset$ and whenever $A\subseteq B_1\cup B_2$ with $B_1, B_2$ closed, then $A\subseteq B_1$ or $A\subseteq B_2$. The space $X$ is called sober if every irreducible closed subset of $X$ is the closure of a unique point.

(2) $X$ is called well-filtered if for every filtered family $\{K_i:i\in I\}$ of compact saturated subsets of $X$ (saturated meaning equal to the intersection of its open neighborhoods) and every open $U\subseteq X$ with $\bigcap_{i\in I}K_i\subseteq U$, there exists $i_0\in I$ with $K_{i_0}\subseteq U$.

(3) A nonempty subset $A\subseteq X$ is called a WD set (well-filtered determined set) if for every continuous map $f:X\to Y$ into a well-filtered $T_0$ space $Y$, the closure $\overline{f(A)}$ in $Y$ equals $\overline{\{y\}}$ for some $y\in Y$.

(4) The space $X$ is called well-filtered determined (a WD space) if every irreducible closed subset of $X$ is a WD set.

Question: Given an arbitrary family $\{X_i:i\in I\}$ of well-filtered determined $T_0$ spaces, is the product space $\prod_{i\in I}X_i$ (with the product topology) again well-filtered determined? Equivalently, is every irreducible closed subset of $\prod_{i\in I}X_i$ a WD set?
artifact.status_search_result: The question of whether products of well-filtered determined spaces are well-filtered determined is listed as an open problem in the literature on non-Hausdorff topology and domain theory. While it is known that products of well-filtered spaces are well-filtered, the analogous question for WD spaces (and related questions for open well-filtered spaces) remain unresolved in recent works on the subject.

status_evidence.title: On T0 spaces determined by well-filtered spaces
status_evidence.snippet: Introduces WD sets and WD spaces; product questions for these classes are posed.
status_evidence.claim: WD spaces and their basic theory are introduced; products of well-filtered spaces shown to be well-filtered, but the WD analogue is left open.

status_evidence.title: Further Studies on Open Well-filtered Spaces
status_evidence.snippet: Related product problems for variants of well-filteredness remain unresolved.
status_evidence.claim: Product problems for well-filtered-type classes are still open in recent work.
